injuries.name: Egor Demin
injuries.detail: Demin (leg) is probable for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Nolan Traore
injuries.detail: Traore (calf) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against New Orleans.

injuries.name: Grant Nelson
injuries.detail: Nelson signed a two-way contract with the Nets on Friday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Norman Powell
injuries.detail: Powell (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game versus the Spurs.

injuries.name: Zach Collins
injuries.detail: Collins (illness) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Spurs.

injuries.name: Tobe Awaka
injuries.detail: Awaka (back) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Spurs.

injuries.name: Sam Merrill
injuries.detail: Merrill (elbow) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Knicks.

injuries.name: Jaylon Tyson
injuries.detail: Tyson (ankle) is questionable to face the Knicks on Wednesday.

injuries.name: Julian Strawther
injuries.detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.detail: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

injuries.name: Brandon Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.

injuries.name: Will Richard
injuries.detail: Richard (thumb) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Houston.

injuries.name: Gary Payton II
injuries.detail: Payton (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against Houston.

injuries.name: Steven Adams
injuries.detail: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could return as soon as Sunday's game at Washington, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Clint Capela
injuries.detail: Head coach Ime Udoka stated Monday that Capela (ankle) could be cleared to return either Nov. 15 in Washington or Nov. 16 in Miami, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
injuries.detail: Haliburton (hamstring) is progressing well but does not have a timetable to return, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy
injuries.detail: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.detail: McConnell is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Wizards due to a strained right hamstring.

injuries.name: Quentin Grimes
injuries.detail: Grimes (finger) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game in Milwaukee.

injuries.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
injuries.detail: Pippen (back) remains out for Wednesday's game against Denver, Michael Wallace of the Grizzlies' official site reports.

injuries.name: Isaiah Stewart
injuries.detail: Stewart (knee) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game versus the Nuggets.

injuries.name: Quinten Post
injuries.detail: Post (concussion) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Nuggets.

injuries.name: Richie Saunders
injuries.detail: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Tyler Herro
injuries.detail: Herro (knee) is listed as out for Tuesday's game against New York.

injuries.name: Trey Murphy III
injuries.detail: Murphy (knee) is probable for Wednesday's game against the Nets.

injuries.name: Yves Missi
injuries.detail: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Trendon Watford
injuries.detail: Watford (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Nets.

injuries.name: Josh Hart
injuries.detail: Hart (illness) won't play Tuesday against the Bucks, Kristian Winfield of the New York Daily News reports.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMaho

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Trail Blazers.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.detail: Sorber (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Suggs
injuries.detail: Suggs (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Kings.

injuries.name: Tristan da Silva
injuries.detail: Da Silva (calf) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Kings, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.detail: Isaac (knee) is out for Tuesday's game against Sacramento.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.detail: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.detail: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

injuries.name: Ja Morant

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.detail: Head coach Micah Nori said that Krejci suffered a left leg fracture during Wednesday's 132-119 win over the Suns, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.detail: Harris (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Chicago, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Devin Vassell
injuries.detail: Vassell (groin) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game versus the Bulls, NBA reporter Matthew Tynan reports.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Scottie Barnes
injuries.detail: Barnes (groin) is out for Wednesday's game against Boston.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.detail: Leonard (knee) is continuing the reconditioning process, and another update will be provided in one week, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Immanuel Quickley
injuries.detail: Quickley (hamstring) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Boston.

injuries.name: Collin Murray-Boyles
injuries.detail: Murray-Boyles (illness) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Celtics.

injuries.name: Trayce Jackson-Davis
injuries.detail: Jackson-Davis is questionable for Wednesday's game against Boston with an illness.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.detail: Bittle (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Keyonte George
injuries.detail: George (ankle) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Heat.

injuries.name: Lauri Markkanen
injuries.detail: Markkanen is out for Tuesday's game versus the Heat with a right wrist sprain.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.detail: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Reece Beekman
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.detail: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Detroit.
